tasks.title: Laravel frontend bug fix in this repo (project root): the Bootstrap datetimepicker on the attendance index page throws 'datetimepicker component should be placed within a non-static positioned container' (Uncaught runtime error, console). Root cause: pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker's place() (node_modules/pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker/src/js/bootstrap-datetimepicker.js ~line 457) walks up from the input's parent and throws when it finds NO non-static (position != static) ancestor; on this page the input #date (resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/attendance/index.blade.php, ~line 17) sits inside <div class="col-sm-8 row g-3"> whose position is static all the way up to <html>. Fix: give the input's immediate wrapper a non-static position. The file already has a draft edit — VERIFY it is correct and complete, and fix it if needed: the wrapper div must be <div class="col-sm-8 row g-3" style="position: relative;"> (inline style is the established convention — the sibling pages resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/attendance/edit.blade.php lines ~100-136 and attendancedailyreport/index.blade.php ~line 19 and attendanceremark/_form.blade.php lines ~23/35 already wrap every picker input in a div with style="position: relative;"; do NOT introduce a position-relative CSS class, the codebase uses inline styles). Do not change any other markup or behavior on the page. Then run php artisan view:cache and confirm the blade compiles cleanly (INFO Blade templates cached successfully), then php artisan view:clear. Report exactly what you changed/verified and the view:cache result.

Verify the datetimepicker container fix in this repo (project root) did not break anything: run the full PHP test suite and the route sanity check. Run `php artisan test` — the suite must stay green (expected baseline: 47 passed / 163 assertions, including the self-contained OutstationEditTest that needs NO database; if any failure appears, report it with the test report contract — do NOT fix it yourself, the Bug Fixer owns fixes). Also run `php artisan route:list --name=attendance` and confirm the attendance.index and attendance.edit routes resolve with the correct middleware. Report the exact test run result (suites, passed, failed) with the test report contract.
